notes: This is a preparation example, not a calibration result. Enter the actual received board geometry; do not infer its model from a shopping suggestion.
The current requested camera role is external_fixed/base_0_rgb. Physically confirm installation; historical wrist_camera topic names do not establish it.
H0 RGB was 640x480; verify the current stream dimensions without resizing. Enter its actual RGB optical frame in camera_frame.

Verify the actual stream's image domain from driver/device processing evidence and real images. Set image_domain=raw or rectified and image_domain_verified=true only after that review; record the evidence. CameraInfo D=0 alone does not decide this.

Raw fits five distortion coefficients. Rectified fixes D=0 and estimates the effective pinhole K for the current rectified stream. Both require real board images, unchanged by additional capture-side resizing or undistortion.
Inner corners are one fewer than square counts in each direction. square_size_m is in metres. Mark a physical origin outside the detection pattern and keep corner numbering consistent.
For external_fixed: camera and robot base stay fixed; board is rigidly attached to a fixed end-effector part, mounted_rigidly_to=gripper.
For wrist: set camera_role=left_wrist_0_rgb and mount_mode=wrist; camera stays rigidly attached to the flange/gripper; board stays fixed relative to base, mounted_rigidly_to=base_world.
Do not use a moving jaw as a fixed board mount. Joint targets are not measured poses; enter T_base_gripper only after verifying the actual FK/model or feedback pose conventions.
Use stationary image captures, actual feedback and reviewed time association. Different views should include rotations around at least two non-parallel axes; H0 J6-only tiny motion is insufficient.
15 training and 5 held-out pose groups are workflow defaults, not a claim of guaranteed accuracy. Reserve held-out views before fitting; do not reuse one pose across splits.

Unverified factory CameraInfo D=0 is not presumed rectified. Fit RGB intrinsics from real board captures and inspect held-out results before hand-eye. Do not overwrite the original CameraInfo evidence.
Raw depth has separate dimensions/intrinsics and is not registered by this tool. RGB calibration requires no depth lookup.
No CAN control, automatic enable, homing, or robot motion is performed by this tool. Real calibration and hand-eye accuracy remain NOT_RUN until actual data exist.
